title: Building – Second Storey Fire Resistance Rating and Base Building Classification January 2015
description: An architect proposed a two-storey tenant fit-out in a sprinklered multi-bay warehouse classified as Group F, Division 2. The second floor of the tenant space was Group D office space over an F3/D main floor.

refusal.basis: not applicable: code-interpretation dispute over a permit refusal; not framed as an alternative solution

outcome_summary: Refusal confirmed: the floor under a superimposed major occupancy takes the lower (F2) occupancy rating, so 2 h with supports.
